extracted_concepts.name: 假设检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 统计推断方法，判断关于总体参数的假设是否成立

extracted_concepts.name: 原假设
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 需要检验的假设 H₀

extracted_concepts.name: 备择假设
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 与 H₀ 对立的假设 H₁

extracted_concepts.name: 检验统计量
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 用于判断 H₀ 是否成立的统计量

extracted_concepts.name: 拒绝域
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 使 H₀ 被拒绝的检验统计量的取值范围

extracted_concepts.name: 接受域
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 使 H₀ 被接受的检验统计量的取值范围

extracted_concepts.name: 显著性水平
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(拒绝 H₀ | H₀ 为真) ≤ α

extracted_concepts.name: 两类错误
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 假设检验中可能犯的第一类与第二类错误

extracted_concepts.name: 第一类错误
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: H₀ 为真时拒绝 H₀，概率 ≤ α

extracted_concepts.name: 第二类错误
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: H₀ 为假时接受 H₀，概率为 β

extracted_concepts.name: Z检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: σ² 已知时检验正态总体均值，Z = (X̄ - μ₀)/(σ/√n)

extracted_concepts.name: t检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: σ² 未知时检验均值，T = (X̄ - μ₀)/(S/√n) ~ t(n-1)

extracted_concepts.name: 双侧检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: H₀: μ = μ₀ vs H₁: μ ≠ μ₀

extracted_concepts.name: 单侧检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: H₀: μ ≤ μ₀ vs H₁: μ > μ₀

extracted_concepts.name: χ²检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 检验正态总体方差，χ² = (n-1)S²/σ₀² ~ χ²(n-1)

extracted_concepts.name: F检验
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 检验两方差比，F = S₁²/S₂² ~ F(n₁-1, n₂-1)

extracted_concepts.name: 两均值差的检验

extracted_concepts.name: 两方差比的检验

extracted_concepts.name: 正态总体
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 服从正态分布的总体，其均值与方差为检验对象

extracted_concepts.name: 样本均值
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 样本的算术平均值 X̄
